\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

% Both the scalar macro and dimension register are snapshotted in setup.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{saved map}{saved map}{
  \def\arrowfactor{2}
  \pgfarrowssave\arrowfactor
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.55pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowssavethe\pgfutil@tempdima
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{\arrowfactor\pgfutil@tempdima}
}{
  \pgfsetroundjoin
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{\arrowfactor\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-\pgfutil@tempdima}{\arrowfactor\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-\pgfutil@tempdima}{-\arrowfactor\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfill
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=17mm and 27mm,
  object/.style={draw,circle,minimum size=10mm,inner sep=1pt}
]
  \node[object,fill=blue!8] (V) {$V$};
  \node[object,fill=green!10,right=of V] (W) {$W$};
  \node[object,fill=orange!10,below=of V] (X) {$X$};
  \node[object,fill=purple!8,right=of X] (Y) {$Y$};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{saved map}] (V) -- node[above] {$f$} (W);
  \draw[purple,line width=1pt,-{saved map}] (X) -- node[below] {$g$} (Y);
  \draw[red,line width=1.6pt,-{saved map}] (V) -- node[left] {$p$} (X);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
